transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, my name is Sofia, how can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Sofia, my video doorbell notifications have been arriving really late, like three to five minutes after someone's actually at the door, which kind of defeats the purpose.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a great point, a delayed doorbell alert really doesn't do much good. Let's get that fixed for you. Can I get your account number, PIN, and the name on the account first?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure, account is 918-442-207, PIN 7734, name is Grace Bennett.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, Grace, that all matches, you're verified. Just to make sure I've got this exactly right: your doorbell notifications are arriving three to five minutes late instead of immediately, is that accurate?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's exactly right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for confirming. When did you first notice this delay?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Probably about five days ago.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, and did anything change around that time, app update, new phone, home network changes?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Actually yes, I got a new phone about a week ago and set the app up fresh on it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a really useful detail, thank you. When you set up the app on the new phone, do you recall which region or country was selected during setup, or did it choose automatically?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It probably picked automatically, I didn't touch anything like that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood, that's actually a common source of this exact issue. Occasionally the notification server region gets auto-assigned incorrectly on a fresh install, which can add several minutes of delay since the notification is routing through a farther server. Let's check what region is currently set. Can you go to the app's Settings, then Notifications, then Advanced?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I'm there.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Does it show a 'Notification Region' or 'Server Region' field?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it says 'Auto (EU-West)'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms it, EU-West would explain the multi-minute delay if you're actually located elsewhere. What region are you in?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm in the US, Pacific time zone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That lines up perfectly then, that region mismatch is almost certainly the entire cause. Let's manually set it to the correct region instead of leaving it on auto. Do you see an option to change it manually?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, there's a dropdown, I can pick US-West.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Go ahead and select that, then the app may ask you to restart it for the change to apply.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Selected US-West... yes, it's asking me to restart the app now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Go ahead and restart it whenever you're ready.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, restarting now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Alright, it's back open and showing connected.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, let's test it to make sure the delay is actually gone. Do you have someone who could press the doorbell right now, or could you trigger a motion test from the app?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I can trigger a test motion event from the app settings.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, go ahead and do that, and let me know how long the notification takes to arrive.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Triggering it now... okay wow, that came through almost instantly, maybe one or two seconds.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's exactly what we want to see, a night and day difference from three to five minutes. Let's do one more test just to be fully sure it wasn't a fluke, can you trigger it again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure... yeah, instant again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent, two for two, that region setting was definitely the root cause. I'm really glad we tracked that down rather than it being something more complicated.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Me too, honestly, this makes total sense now that you explain it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Happy to walk through it. Since you mentioned this started with the new phone, is there anything else on that phone's setup you'd like me to double check while I have you, just to be thorough?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Actually yes, could you check if my notification sound and vibration settings carried over correctly too?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sure, let's check, go to Notifications, then Sound and Vibration.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I'm there, sound is on, vibration is on, looks normal.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good, those carried over fine then, no issue there.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great, one less thing to worry about.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the region setting ever reset itself automatically, like after another app update?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It shouldn't, since you've now set it manually rather than leaving it on auto, it should stick through future updates. If it ever does reset though, you now know exactly where to check and fix it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good to know, I feel a lot more confident handling it myself if it ever happens again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's exactly the goal. While we're in settings, do you want me to check if there's a way to see delivery timestamps for past notifications, just so you have a way to verify things are staying fast?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh yeah, that'd be useful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under Activity History there should be a log showing when each event happened and when the notification was sent.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me check... yes, I can see today's test events with matching timestamps now, that's helpful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, that'll be a good way to spot-check things over the next few days if you want extra peace of mind.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does this region setting affect anything else besides notifications, like live video streaming speed?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good question, it can actually, live view latency is sometimes tied to the same regional routing, so you may notice the live feed loading a bit faster now too.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, I hadn't even thought to check that, let me try.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pulling up live view now... yeah, that loaded almost instantly, definitely faster than I remember it being before.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a great secondary confirmation that the fix addressed the root cause properly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This has honestly been such a smooth call, thank you for being so thorough.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That really means a lot to hear, thank you. Is there anything else at all I can help you look into today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Actually, one more, does the app support multiple doorbells if I ever add a second one, or would that need a separate account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Same account, you can add as many compatible devices as you own, they'll all show up together in the same app.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good to know, I've been considering a side-door camera too.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you do add one later, just double check it picks up the same region setting we just fixed, sometimes new devices default back to auto.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good tip, I'll definitely check that when the time comes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the doorbell camera itself need a firmware check too, or is this purely an app-side fix?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good question, let's check anyway just to be thorough, can you go to the doorbell's device page and look for firmware version?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, checking... it says version 3.4.0, no pending update shown.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's current, so no action needed there, this really was purely the app-side region setting.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good, glad we double-checked anyway.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Always worth ruling things out fully rather than assuming.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the app store any video clips locally, or is it all cloud-based?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: By default it's cloud-based with a rolling history, unless you've added a local storage card to the hub.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I don't think I have one, so cloud it is.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a perfectly fine default for most households.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How many days of cloud history do I get with my current plan?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your plan includes a fourteen day rolling history.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh that's more generous than I expected, good to know.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yeah, it's one of the better perks of that plan tier.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there an option to extend that further if I ever wanted a longer archive?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, there's a sixty day extended history add-on available if you ever want more than the default two weeks.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good to know, I'll think about whether I need that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No rush at all, the default fourteen days works well for most people.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the doorbell support two-way audio, so I can actually talk to whoever's at the door?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, if you tap the live feed there should be a microphone icon, holding it down lets you speak through the doorbell's speaker.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh perfect, I didn't realize that, that'll be handy for deliveries.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly the kind of situation it's built for.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can my husband also get notifications on his phone, or does it need to go through my account only?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: He can be added as a secondary user under Household Members, he'd get his own login and his own notifications from his own device.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh great, he's been wanting that, I'll set it up after this call.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a quick process, just his email address and he'll get an invite.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Perfect. Does he get to customize his own notification timing too, or does it copy my settings?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: His own, each household member manages their preferences independently.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good, he probably doesn't want every single motion alert like I do.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That flexibility is exactly there for situations like that.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there a way to set different notification behavior at different times of day, like quiet hours?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, under Notifications there's a Quiet Hours option where you can set a time range to mute alerts, motion events still get logged, just without the push notification.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh that's great for late at night, let me set that up.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Setting quiet hours from 11pm to 6am... done.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, that should help with any late night notifications while still keeping a full record for the morning.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Exactly what I wanted, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the motion detection sensitivity get affected by the notification region setting at all, or are those separate?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Those are completely separate systems, sensitivity is a local camera setting, the region setting only affected how fast the alert traveled once triggered.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good, that clears up my confusion on that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Happy to clarify, that's a fair thing to wonder about.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there anything I should watch for over the next few days just to make sure this stays fixed?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just keep an eye on notification timing for a day or two, but based on both tests coming back instant and the live view improving too, I'm confident this is fully resolved.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: One more thing, does S-Net ever proactively flag region mismatches like this, or is it purely something a customer has to notice and call about?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a fair question, right now it's mostly customer-reported like today, though I'll make a note on your account about this pattern in case it helps flag something similar for others down the line.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's a thoughtful thing to do, I appreciate that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Happy to, feedback loops like that genuinely help improve things over time.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does switching phones in the future risk this same region issue resetting again?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's possible on a brand new install, so if you ever get another phone, it's worth checking that region setting proactively during setup.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good to know, I'll remember to check that specifically next time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That'll save you from having to troubleshoot this again from scratch.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's reassuring, I really appreciate all the help today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. So just to close things out, can you confirm for me that the doorbell notifications are now working properly and this issue is fully resolved for you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, absolutely, everything's working instantly now, this is completely resolved. Thank you so much, Sofia.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Before you go, is there a direct line or reference number I should mention if I ever call back about this same account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your account number works fine for that, and I'm also adding detailed notes on this call so whoever you reach next will have the full context immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's great, saves me from re-explaining everything from scratch.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly the idea, glad that's helpful.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Perfect, I think that's genuinely everything now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sounds good, thank you for being so patient and thorough with me while we worked through all of this today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Of course, this was a genuinely great experience, thank you Sofia.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful, I'm really glad we got that sorted out for you today. Thank you for choosing S-Net.
